source.title: Fence concurrent RDC and Computer-Use UI control globally
source.objective: RDC/Computer-Use global single-writer missing: during Grindr/Pixel work multiple ChatGPT/Codex origin_instance values were concurrently issuing Remote Desktop Commander calls to the same Fedora bridge, while chatgpt-rdc-supervisor and an old cua-repl were also alive. This can produce overlapping UI/device control and apparent zombie actions (including unexpected desktop UI changes). Need one global authority/lease across RDC + CUA + supervisors, stale-worker fencing, and a PANIC STOP that revokes all UI-control writers without disabling the desired foreground session.
